title: Aurora Chronicles
tagline: A century-long saga of explorers stitching time back together.

events.title: The Aurora Expedition Sets Sail
events.description: Captain Lira Solis launches humanity's first expedition to map the temporal seas, departing from the orbital drydock above New Asteria.

events.title: First Contact with the Tide Wardens
events.description: Navigators encounter the Tide Wardens, enigmatic beings who guard fractured moments in history. A fragile truce allows the crew to continue their mission.

events.title: Rescue at the Broken Meridian
events.description: Chief engineer Oren Malik reroutes the ship's chronoflux drives to free a lost colony frozen between minutes, saving over 6,000 settlers.

events.title: The Solstice Accord
events.description: Representatives from twelve worlds convene aboard the Aurora to sign an accord that limits unauthorized timefold experimentation.

events.title: Return to a Healed Horizon
events.description: After fifteen years, the expedition completes its final map of the stabilized timeline and returns home to a world forever changed by their discoveries.
